summary: Tested the Vade Hatırlatma (reminders) feature end-to-end: backend permissions, settings PUT validation, send-now (items/sent and items=0 branch), cron auth (401 w/o or wrong Bearer), duplicate X-Webhook-Id dedupe, cron does-not-resend when reminded=True, and PUT /transactions resets reminded. Also verified UI RemindersCard switch, days-input blur, recipient checkbox, and Şimdi Gönder flow. 2 real emails sent to admin only (within budget).
critical_code_review_comments: reminders.py uses os.environ['WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET'] at request time; good — no import-time crash if the key rotates, but a KeyError bubbles up as 500 instead of 503. Consider wrapping with a clear 'cron disabled' response if ever unset.
run_reminders fetches up to 500 pending txs and up to 50 users without pagination/metrics; fine for MVP but worth logging the result dict so ops can audit cron runs beyond `last_result`.
cron endpoint stores run_id in db.cron_runs but never TTLs the collection — recommend a TTL index on created_at (e.g. 30 days) to keep the dedupe table bounded.
send-now ignores the `enabled=False` setting (manual=True path) which is correct, but there's no audit trail of who clicked it — consider recording the acting user in last_result.
mailer._assert_safe_email is a nice guard; template uses escape() consistently — good. Consider also escaping cari names used in anchor text (already escape()'d, OK).

success_rate.backend: 100% (16/16 after fixing a test-only ordering bug; initial run was 15/16 — code was correct, test setup needed to force reminded=True via Mongo after an earlier PUT reset it. Verified in isolation via /tmp/verify_reminded_skip.py which returned items=0, sent=0, no email.)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (RemindersCard switch, days-input blur save+persistence after reload, recipient toggle, Şimdi Gönder — last-run timestamp updated)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reminders tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_reminders.py and share a module-level _state dict + an autouse teardown fixture that calls admin API + Mongo cleanup. Pytest xdist loadscope keeps the module on a single worker. CAUTION: run_reminders(manual=False) is called asynchronously via BackgroundTasks for the cron endpoint — tests sleep 3s then poll /api/settings/reminders.last_result. Emails are REAL via Emergent Resend; keep recipient_ids=[admin] and prefer recipient_ids=[] to exercise the pipeline without sending. PUT /api/transactions/{id} resets `reminded`=False (server.py line 424).
rca of the issue: Transient test-only failure: TestCron.test_cron_does_not_resend_reminded expected last_result.items==0 but got 1. Root cause was the preceding TestSendNow.test_send_now_items_zero_when_none which used admin.put to move due_date out of the window; PUT /transactions resets reminded to False as a side effect (by design). The test therefore ran against a tx with reminded=False and cron correctly picked it up (items=1, sent=1). Fix: directly set reminded=True via Mongo in the test setup so we isolate the cron 'skip reminded' branch. Code is correct — this was a test-ordering bug. Verified independently with /tmp/verify_reminded_skip.py which produced items=0, sent=0, no email.
